add-column: The three claim columns are nullable and default-free, a catalog-only addition to reader notes without a rewrite, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
add-constraint: The widened target-type and claim-shape CHECKs are added NOT VALID without scanning existing notes, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout; the online phase validates them after the schema lock is released.
add-foreign-key: The matter key is added NOT VALID, so existing notes (all with a null matter) are not scanned, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout; the online phase validates it.
create-policy: Replacing the reader-note policies installs catalog metadata without reading rows, with DDL lock acquisition bounded by 1s and the statement by 5s.
create-trigger: The statement-level claim cleanup trigger installs metadata on the claims table without scanning rows, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
row-level-security: FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on reader notes changes only catalog flags; the owner paths it affects get their own policies in the same migration, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
